law_name: Copyright and Related Rights Act No. 42 of 2000 (amended 2017 and 2021)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (s. 19); joint works life of last surviving author + 50 years; collective, audiovisual and anonymous works 50 years; applied art 25 years
moral_rights: Moral rights recognized (s. 9), independent of economic rights
notes: Assented 29 Dec 2000, in force 8 Feb 2011. Berne 27 Dec 2012, WTO 24 Aug 2012, WCT 6 Aug 2020 (Commons). Amendment Act 10 of 2021 effective 24 Nov 2021; its effect on s. 19 not checked.
